methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Prusa Research is a bootstrapped robotics and manufacturing company founded by Josef Průša. The valuation universe consists of 11 peers across the Robotics & Manufacturing sector, including 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms. Notable private comparables include Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

A peer-median approach was not applicable in this case. The sector contains 11 same-sector peers, but zero companies meeting narrow stage and valuation-tier filters simultaneously. The analysis requires a minimum of three datapoints within comparable stage and tier bands to be analytically defensible; the available peer set did not satisfy this threshold. Relying on an all-sector median would conflate stage heterogeneity and introduce material bias.

The analysis cannot deliver a triangulated valuation range without methodological support. The single public comparable and fragmented private cohort lack sufficient clustering around Prusa's stage and operational profile to anchor multiples-based or precedent-transaction analysis. Key uncertainties include Prusa's current revenue run rate, profitability profile, and capital efficiency relative to the named private peers—data not available in the provided set. A credible valuation would require either (1) identification of 3+ stage-matched comparables with disclosed metrics, or (2) bottom-up analysis grounded in unit economics and forward financial projections.
